prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single production game building sprite.
Primary request: Recreate the supplied Mortar level reference as a fresh high resolution 3D-rendered fantasy mobile strategy game sprite. The reference is the structural and colour guide: match its raised short wide cylindrical barrel, open dark bore, tilt, timber-and-metal carriage and small side supports faithfully. The object must have the same silhouette and the same southeast isometric orthographic viewing angle. Do NOT replace the carriage with a circular stone foundation. No decorative additions or extra barrels.
Style: crisp beveled forms, smooth hand-painted materials, controlled highlights, clean readable details at small game scale, cheerful Clash-of-Clans-like visual language. Match the reference's component proportions and colour placement. Light from upper left with soft ambient occlusion between components.
Composition: ONE complete isolated Mortar centered in a square 1024x1024 image with generous clear margin, entire feet and barrel visible. The object occupies about 75% of image width and height. Keep its contact plane horizontal in isometric perspective. No text, numerals, UI, watermark, frame, grass, ground tile or scenery.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, no checkerboard, no solid background, no cast shadow outside the object's silhouette.
Level-specific design: Level 1: plain dark gray iron barrel, slim unadorned dark muzzle lip, light tan timber carriage and dark metal fasteners, a few cool gray metal end caps. Humble and unarmored.
